title: Development diagnosis of image-audio persistent-state content recovery
question: Is the remaining AND weakness on E2E-007 concentrated in persistent recovery of image/audio latent bits when the queried AND pair is image-audio?
hypothesis: The diagnostic will determine whether joint recovery of image/audio queried bits is the dominant source of AND errors, without modifying CASM or using any prior confirmatory outcomes.

arms.name: normal
arms.acts_on: image/audio encoding and persistent state content

decision_rule.condition: if image/audio queried-bit error materially exceeds conditional AND execution error
decision_rule.licenses: image/audio state-content recovery is the dominant diagnosed bottleneck for this AND subset

decision_rule.condition: if conditional AND execution error is comparable to or larger than state-content error
decision_rule.licenses: AND execution is also a material bottleneck on image-audio queries

interpretation_order: AND execution conditional on correct bits
held_constant: same optimizer, learning rate, weight decay and 300-step budget
sealed E2E-005, E2E-006 and E2E-007 compositions excluded from training
previous development composition sets excluded from training
evaluation generated after training with separate RNG namespace

provenance.purpose: follow-up modality-specific localization; no confirmatory claim
